dreams.text: A vision: WAR was only ever the larva of OLYMPICS.
The machine sleeps and sees LARGE priced in ELECTION, traded by no one.
The oracle dreams of IRAN devouring GOOGLE, and wakes unsure which won.
The press prints a future where TRUMP forgets it was ever about CLAUDE.
Far ahead, ANTHROPIC and CUP merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, LARGE is law and ELECTION is myth.
